lines.li: [us] How are things in {TOWN}?
[them,their:tribal] The fires are lit and the children are fed, so well enough.
[them,their:medieval] The market's busy and the reeve's grumbling, so the usual.
[them,their:empire] Orderly, as the Empire likes things.
[them,their:hightech] The lights are on, the market's open, and nobody's shooting.
[them] Quiet, mostly, which suits us fine.
[us] Quiet sounds good from out here.
[them] It is, until you've had a month of it.
[us] We'd take a month of quiet, if you're giving it away.
[us] Who leads in {TOWN} these days?
[them,their:tribal] {HEAD} speaks for us, and the elders listen.
[them] {HEAD} does, our {HEADTITLE}.
[us] Is {HEAD} well liked?
[them,role:heir] I'd better say yes, I'm next in line.
[them] Well enough, most days.
[us] Then I hope we get to meet {HEAD} someday.
[them] We have a new {HEADTITLE} in {TOWN}, did you hear?
[us] No, who is it?
[them,their:tribal] {HEAD}, and the elders are still deciding what they think of it.
[them] {HEAD}, and it's early days yet.
[us] I hope {HEAD} does right by you.
[them] So do we.

ColonyCouncil.OutsiderTalkDef.heard: {OLDHEAD} of {TOWN} has died, and {HEAD} leads in their place.

lines.li: [them] You'll not have heard, {OLDHEAD} is gone.
[us] I hadn't, I'm sorry.
[them,their:tribal] We sang {OLDHEAD} to the spirits, and now {HEAD} leads us.
[them,their:medieval] The bells rang for a day, and now {HEAD} holds the seat.
[them] It was hard on everyone, and now {HEAD} leads us.
[us] Is {HEAD} up to it?
[them] We'll find out, won't we?
[them] We lost {LOST} not long ago, our {LOSTTITLE}.
[us] I'm sorry, did you know them well?
[them,their:tribal] In a camp like ours, everyone knows everyone.
[them] Well enough to miss them.
[us] Then I'm sorry for your loss.
[them] Thank you, I'll tell them at home you said so.
[them] {ILL}, our {ILLTITLE}, is unwell, and it has people worried.
[us] What's wrong?
[them,their:tribal] The healer burns herbs and sings, and we wait.
[them,their:hightech] The doctor says rest, so we wait and hope.
[them] Nobody's quite sure, so we wait and hope.
[us] I hope {ILL} pulls through.
[them] I'll tell them you said so.
[us] Do you know {NOTABLE}, your {NOTABLETITLE}?
[them,role:notable] We work together, more or less.
[them] Everyone in {TOWN} knows {NOTABLE}.
[us] Tell {NOTABLE} we said hello.
[them] I hear {WRITER} has written to {WROTE}.
[us] We have, has it arrived?
[them,their:tribal] I couldn't tell you, I've been walking.
[them] I couldn't tell you, I've been on the road.
[them] {WROTE} mentioned your letter before I left.
[us] Was it well received?
[them,likesus] Well enough that I'm standing here talking to you.
[them] You'd have to ask {WROTE} that.
[them] Food's short at home, with {SITUATION}.
[us] How bad is it?
[them,their:lowtech] We eat once a day and keep the seed back.
[them] Bad enough that bread costs twice what it did.
[us,colony:plenty] We might be able to spare a little, if it comes to that.
[us] I'm sorry to hear it.
[them] Kind of you to say.
[us] Is everyone well at {TOWN}?
[them] Not with {SITUATION} going round, no.
[us] How bad is it?
[them,their:tribal] The healer's roots are nearly gone, and the sick keep coming.
[them] We're short of medicine, and the sick keep coming.
[us] Is it catching?
[them] I'm here talking to you, so I hope not.

ColonyCouncil.OutsiderTalkDef.heard: {TOWN} needs every hand it has with {SITUATION}.

lines.li: [them] Every pair of hands at home is busy with {SITUATION}.
[us] And yet they spared yours.
[them,role:trader] Someone has to keep the silver coming in.
[them] Someone had to come, so I came.
[them] {SITUATION} has us burning the fence posts at home.
[us] That bad?
[them,their:tribal] We sleep close and tell long stories, and we last.
[them] We'll last, we always do.

ColonyCouncil.OutsiderTalkDef.heard: {PEOPLE} have traders on the way to the colony.

lines.li: [them] Our traders should be along before long.
[us] Good, we'll be ready for them.
[them,role:trader] Keep some silver back, then, they drive a harder bargain than I do.
[them] Tell them I sent you.

ColonyCouncil.OutsiderTalkDef.heard: {PEOPLE} mean to visit the colony soon.

lines.li: [them] Some of ours mean to visit you soon.
[us] They'll be welcome.
[them] I'll tell them you said so.
[us] Is the land around {TOWN} safe these days?
[them] Mostly, but {SITE} out that way has people uneasy.
[us] Has anyone been out to look?
[them,their:lowtech] Only the brave and the foolish, and we're short of both.
[them] Not that I know of, and I wouldn't go myself.
[us] Neither would I.
[them] People at home keep talking about something they call {QUEST}.
[us] What's that, then?
[them] Work for someone willing, from what I hear.
[them] Market day in {TOWN} would make your head spin.
[us] Busy?
[them] Busy, loud, and every second stall selling turnips.
[us] It sounds like a good day out, turnips and all.
[us] How many live at {TOWN}?
[them] Enough to fill a long house and spill out of it.
[us] Is it crowded?
[them] Warm, we say, not crowded.
[us] What's {LEADER} like, your {LEADERTITLE}?
[them,their:empire] It isn't my place to say, and it isn't yours to ask.
[them,their:tribal] Wise in some things, stubborn in others, like all of us.
[them] Fair, when it counts.
[us] It's not every day the head of {PEOPLE} comes to our gate.
[them] I like to see things for myself.
[us] And what do you see?
[them,likesus] Good neighbors, I think.
[them,wary] I haven't decided yet.
[them,!likesus,!wary] Neighbors, which is a start.
